note: Internal review scratch. Records the 12 places where the documentation corpus deliberately states something the frozen code does not do. Not linked from index.md and excluded from the checker. Every other claim in docs/ is intended to be accurate.

discrepancies.doc_claim: Commenting is open to every role: `comment:create` carries a `viewer` minimum in ROLE_MATRIX, so a read-only collaborator can reply on a thread without being promoted to member.
discrepancies.code_truth: ROLE_MATRIX["comment:create"] is "member". A viewer is denied with reason denied_by_role; there is no ownership escalation for comment:create (only comment:update and comment:delete).

discrepancies.doc_claim: The digest job runs on the `digest-email` cadence of every 1440 minutes, i.e. once a day.
discrepancies.code_truth: CADENCE_MINUTES["digest-email"] is 60, so the job is eligible hourly. 1440 is the cadence of search-reindex and cleanup-archived. Per-org daily behaviour comes from shouldRunForOrg matching digestHourUtc, not from the cadence.

discrepancies.doc_claim: The search_index table carries an index `search_index_org_updated_idx` on (org_id, updated_at).
discrepancies.code_truth: search_index declares exactly one index, search_index_org_kind_idx on (org_id, subject_kind). No index on updated_at exists.

discrepancies.doc_claim: createProjectAction can return the error code `rate_limited`.
discrepancies.code_truth: The action never calls consumeRateLimit and has no rate-limit bucket. It can produce validation_failed, forbidden, plan_limit_exceeded and internal_error only. Its own entry correctly lists the rate limit bucket as none.

discrepancies.doc_claim: The project quota ladder is 3 projects on free, 10 on starter, 100 on growth, unlimited on enterprise.
discrepancies.code_truth: PLAN_LIMITS.free.projects is 2, not 3. The starter, growth and enterprise figures quoted are correct.

discrepancies.doc_claim: ai_issue_summary is a percentage rollout at 50%.
discrepancies.code_truth: FEATURE_FLAG_DEFINITIONS.ai_issue_summary.strategy is { kind: "percentage", percent: 25 }. Other documents in the corpus state 25 correctly.

discrepancies.doc_claim: project:archive is gated at owner in ROLE_MATRIX, the same minimum as project:delete, so an admin cannot archive a project.
discrepancies.code_truth: ROLE_MATRIX["project:archive"] is "admin"; only project:delete is "owner". An admin can archive a project.

discrepancies.doc_claim: REQ-157 states that MAX_ATTEMPTS is read from WEBHOOK_MAX_ATTEMPTS in src/config/constants.ts rather than hardcoded in the job, and lists constants.ts under Implemented by.
discrepancies.code_truth: webhook-delivery-job.ts declares its own `const MAX_ATTEMPTS = 6` and never imports from src/config/constants.ts. constants.ts does export WEBHOOK_MAX_ATTEMPTS but its value is 5 and nothing reads it. The ceiling check is also `attempts > MAX_ATTEMPTS`, so a seventh attempt is possible.
SESSION_TTL_DAYS is 30. Later passages in the same document state 30 correctly.

discrepancies.doc_claim: The comment:create rate-limit bucket has capacity 60 and refills at 10 per minute.
discrepancies.code_truth: RATE_LIMIT_BUCKETS["comment:create"] is { capacity: 60, refillPerMinute: 20 }. The capacity is right, the refill rate is not.

discrepancies.doc_claim: The flags settings screen requires org:manage_flags, described as member and above.
discrepancies.code_truth: ROLE_MATRIX["org:manage_flags"] is "admin". A member fails the check and the page calls notFound(). The same document describes the billing and webhook screens' minimums correctly.

discrepancies.doc_claim: The unique index issues_project_number_idx covers (org_id, number), making an issue number unique across the whole organization.
discrepancies.code_truth: issues_project_number_idx is uniqueIndex on (project_id, number) — numbering is per project, as REQ-061 states elsewhere in the corpus.
